definitions.explanation: Providing a benefit or advantage; in a position that is likely to lead to success.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有利|ゆうり}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: These conditions are favorable to us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有利|ゆうり}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is in an advantageous position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{有利|ゆうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}めたい→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to advance the negotiations in our favor.

notes:
{有利|ゆうり} is a na-adjective describing situations, conditions, or positions that provide an advantage or benefit.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {有利|ゆうり}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (favorable conditions)
- Adverbial: {有利|ゆうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧ (to advance favorably)
{有|ゆう} (to have) + {利|り} (benefit, advantage)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {有利|ゆうり}な⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧: advantageous position
- {有利|ゆうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work in one's favor
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{有利|ゆうり}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: to be advantageous to ~
- {有利|ゆうり}な⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧: favorable terms

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不利|ふり}→不利：03603_furi⟧: disadvantageous, unfavorable (antonym)
- ⟦{有益|ゆうえき}→有益：13004_yuueki⟧: beneficial, useful (broader in meaning)
